title: A look at React, Angular and Vue, from where Svelte stands

videos.script:
The last lesson looks out of the window. {{same}} React, Vue and Angular solve the problem Svelte solves, and almost everything in this course has a name in each of them.

Then one small component, written four times and built four times. {{counters}} You will see what each framework sends to the browser for a single button, and what that number does and does not mean.

Then the difference you cannot see in a counter. {{update}} When a value changes, how does each framework find the text to change?

Then the application frameworks around them, {{around}} and the one row of the comparison where SvelteKit stands apart: the form that works with JavaScript off.

And last, an honest account {{choosing}} of what Svelte costs, what it gives, and what carries over whichever you choose.
